results.name: Oracle health check returns ok
Public catalog and exam metadata omit answer keys
Missing CSRF token is rejected with HTTP 400
Anonymous account and admin endpoints require authentication
Registration ignores injected administrator roles
Student, teacher and editor policies enforce least privilege
QA profile and password update affect only the authenticated account
Administrator metadata and media upload validate permissions, size and signatures
Administrator creates and edits QA questions with correct Part 2 choices
Draft exam CRUD, duplicate question rejection and full-test structure validation
Draft exams stay private and cannot start; publishing requires complete groups
Questions in a published exam reject modification and deletion
One active attempt per user/exam is preserved across concurrent starts
A different QA account cannot read, answer or submit another account attempt
Duplicate, foreign-question and invalid-choice answer payloads are rejected
Answer updates replace previous choices instead of appending score entries
Attempt snapshots survive draft conversion and later question answer changes
Submission uses snapshot keys, caps scores, and remains idempotent
QA lesson and vocabulary CRUD plus saved-word lifecycle work
Oracle expiry finalizes the QA attempt and refuses late answer mutation
Deleting used QA exams/questions archives them; unused QA content deletes
Disabling a QA account invalidates its existing authentication cookie
All 20 Oracle example queries execute and every business table has five rows

scope: Real HTTP requests against local ASP.NET Core API and Oracle 19c; only timestamped QA records are changed. No instance administration or physical restore is executed.
